messages.text:
Good evening,
I noticed that the HarloLabs pool website was updated a few nights ago.
After the update, I found that I had been logged out and my bolt balance
was missing. I signed back in using the same email address, but my balance
still shows 0.
I believe I had approximately 25,000–40,000 bolts.
While that may not be a large amount, I would appreciate your help
restoring my balance so I don’t have to start over.
Thank you,
Jon P.

My pool account was registered under (email hidden)
My Labs account uses the same email address. I also signed up in time for
the 200,000-bolt signup bonus, but it hasn’t appeared in my account yet.
Handed to the team · Pool account balances and bonuses are not something Hal can see or change. Someo

Hi Jon,

Thanks for the clear details. I'm sorry the update logged you out and left your balance showing zero.

I can't see or change bolt balances on the pool from my side. I've passed everything to the team: your email ((email hidden), the same for the pool and Labs), the estimate of roughly 25,000 to 40,000 bolts from before the update, and the 200,000-bolt signup bonus you signed up for that hasn't shown up yet. They'll check your account as it was before the update and look at the bonus.

The team is offline for the weekend and will pick this up tomorrow at 10am ET. They'll reply here by email. You don't need to do anything else for now, and please keep mining as usual in the meantime.

Best regards,
Hal, HeliumDeploy Technical Support

handoffs: Pool account balances and bonuses are not something Hal can see or change. Someo
